messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-queue-growth (gpu-pool-usw2) > 80% for 12m. HPA queries returning no metrics (custom.metrics.k8s.io). autoscale-failure=true

nina (oncall-sre): i'm oncall and looking now. paging @kiran @tom. initial hypothesis: custom metrics not reaching HPA -> no scale up -> queue grows

kiran (eng-runtime): can you paste the hpa status? also check custom-metrics-adapter logs

nina (oncall-sre): ```
kubectl -n inference get hpa gpu-serving -o wide
# NAME          REFERENCE           TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
# gpu-serving   Deployment/gpu-srv   <missing>   5        50        10         3h
```

kiran (eng-runtime): <missing> == adapter returning stale/no metrics. grabbing adapter logs

nina (oncall-sre): ```
kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/custom-metrics-adapter -c adapter --tail=200
# 2026-11-02T09:14:01Z WARN query prometheus timeout ctx=5s
# 2026-11-02T09:14:04Z ERROR upstream error: 503 Service Unavailable (prom-usw2-0)
# 2026-11-02T09:14:07Z ERROR adapter: failed to translate metrics: upstream stale
# 2026-11-02T09:14:10Z WARN high request latency to prometheus
```

kiran (eng-runtime): adapter is timing out contacting prometheus. check prometheus health + remote_write backlog

tom (platform): looking at prom-usw2-0: CPU 99%, memory pressure, many restarts of prom container in last 20m. remote_write queue ~2.1M samples. there's a high-cardinality spike from gpu-exporter v2: new labels per-pod after faulty deploy at 08:58 UTC. this is saturating prom.

emily (customer-success): CS note: multiple customers report elevated latencies and 503s on inference endpoints since ~09:05 UTC. tickets created: INC-SRV-749 and INC-SRV-750. customers: brightline & marketgrid. They're asking for ETA.

nina (oncall-sre): mitigation plan: 1) emergency manual scale of gpu-serving to relieve backlog 2) temporarily throttle/route heavy tenants to degraded plan 3) fix prometheus pressure (revert exporter deploy) or repoint adapter to replica 4) make HPA fallback if custom metrics unavailable

kiran (eng-runtime): agree. manual scale now to buy time. also prepare a patch to adapter config to use prom-usw2-1 if needed

nina (oncall-sre): executing manual scale:```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/gpu-serving --replicas=30
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/gpu-serving --watch=false
```

deploy-bot: action logged: scaled inference/gpu-serving -> 30 replicas by nina at 09:20 UTC

k8s-autoscaler-bot: HPA check: metrics missing -> desiredReplicas unchanged at 10. Polling continues every 30s

nina (oncall-sre): after scale, queue depth dropped from ~1.1k -> 320 over 7m. p50 latency for sample trace went from 2.8s -> 720ms. partial recovery.

tom (platform): i'm starting revert of gpu-exporter v2 to stable v1. also preparing to restart prom-usw2-0 if needed. but want to avoid losing long-term metrics; prefer to repoint adapter to prom-usw2-1 first.

kiran (eng-runtime): patching adapter configmap to use prom-usw2-1 endpoint now and scaling adapter to 4 replicas

kiran (eng-runtime): ```
kubectl -n kube-system patch cm/custom-metrics-config -p '{"data":{"prometheus_endpoint":"https://prom-usw2-1.internal"}}'
kubectl -n kube-system scale deploy/custom-metrics-adapter --replicas=4
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deploy/custom-metrics-adapter
```

nina (oncall-sre): adapter warmup logs show success: returning custom metrics for gpu_queue_length at 09:34 UTC. hpa observed metrics and recalculated desiredReplicas

k8s-autoscaler-bot: detected new metric -> desiredReplicas=28 -> scaling event triggered
deploy-bot: node autoscaler event: scaled gpu-nodepool-usw2 by +3 nodes at 09:36 UTC

emily (customer-success): CS update: customers reported error rates dropping after 09:40 UTC. follow-ups queued with customers; we'll keep them informed.

nina (oncall-sre): root cause (initial hypothesis): bad gpu-exporter v2 deploy introduced excessive label cardinality -> prometheus overwhelmed -> adapter timeouts -> HPA lacked metrics -> no autoscale -> queue growth -> customer impact.

tom (platform): actioned revert of exporter at 09:28 UTC; prom-usw2-0 GC reclaimed memory; but adapter repoint prevented further customer impact while prom recovered.

kiran (eng-runtime): long-term fixes suggested: - add exporter label sanitation/rate limit - prom: increase resources + tune remote_write queue - adapter: implement multi-prom endpoint failover + healthcheck + metric-staleness alert - HPA: set CPU fallback for staleness > 60s

alex (oncall-day): taking handoff at 10:00 UTC. summary: manual scale + adapter repoint + exporter revert mitigated. monitoring set to alert on queue > 60% for 5m and adapter_stale_metrics > 30s.

emily (customer-success): created CS post-incident messages and will follow up with SLAs where required.

nina (oncall-sre): creating postmortem doc PM-INC-749-gpu-autoscale-metrics-lag. owners: tom (prom resiliency), kiran (adapter failover & HPA fallback), nina (exporter revert + canary test).

incident-bot: incident status -> resolved (degraded). severity: Sev2. Postmortem required.

alex (oncall-day): ack. I'll monitor for 2 hours and then start the RCA writeup. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
